description: A research dataset assembled and analyzed by Eric Isenberg and colleagues containing teacher effectiveness, student income, hiring, transfer, and attrition information for fourth- through eighth-grade teachers in 26 U.S.
title: 26-district teacher effectiveness dataset covering grades 4-8 over five school years (2008-2009 to 2012-2013)

description: A Brazilian Portuguese 26-item Likert self-report assessment developed by the study authors to measure obstetric-procedure self-confidence among medical clerkship students across comprehension and preparation, procedural knowledge, motivation, expectation, and interest.
title: 26-item five-subscale self-confidence questionnaire adapted from Scholz et al.

description: A 26-item five-point Likert survey developed from Awidi et al.'s FLOWER dimensions to measure medical students' perceived determinants of e-learning experience.
title: 26-item FLOWER survey instrument measuring six e-learning experience dimensions
